Planned build: nothing counts as working until its test in docs/HARDWARE.md passes. Dashed = power stage still to design and validate.
Joins the same hotspot as the Pi
2.4 GHz band for the Zero 2 W
Check: board must NOT use GPIO18
Debian 13 Trixie · host AIRA · user aira
SYS is not a 5 V rail
Until validated: a known-good 5 V 2.5 A supply into PWR IN, amp from the same supply.
40-pin header plan (common "3.5inch RPi LCD (A)" display layout — confirm on your board)
36 = GPIO16: keep free (used by the googlevoicehat overlay if chosen)
Wire colours: red 5 V · orange 3.3 V · black GND · yellow BCLK · green LRCLK · blue mic data · purple DAC data · white/grey button · grey line audio
I²S wires short (< 10 cm). Mic far from the speakers. Never feed the INMP441 5 V. Back up /boot/firmware/config.txt before adding overlays.
